verdict.rationale: Gram is an MCP gateway and control plane, so runtime tool discovery through meta-tools is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows curated toolsets, a catalog of approved tools, and on-demand loading of SKILL.md instruction manifests. None of that is a meta-tool (e.g. search_tools or load_tool) that lets an agent find and load tool definitions at runtime instead of receiving the full tool list. Skills load instructions, not tool schemas, and the Docs MCP search covers documentation content, not tools.
